resources.string: Android pauses background apps to save battery, which can silence TOWEMS alerts and stop the driver tracker while the screen is off.\n\nAllow TOWEMS to run without battery restrictions. On Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo and vivo phones, also switch on Autostart for TOWEMS in Settings.
Keep tracking with the screen off

The driver tracker reports the vehicle position during a run. If TOWEMS may only use location while it is open, tracking stops as soon as the phone locks.\n\nOn the next screen choose Allow all the time.
